title: Feature request: to add Photos from Meal on Notice/Carbs treatment.
body:
When you can add a photo from the meal on carbs/notice treatment, would be nice.
To save it on nightscout too: https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/issues/2757

comments.body:
@diabetesdt1 Would you please explain in more detail what this request is?
Do you want to upload photos of your food?  
So, if you have chicken tonight, you will take a picture of it and upload it?  And if next week you have chicken again, you will upload another photo?
Why?
If this is not a request any more, would you please close the issue?
Thanks
